value.rationale: Natural complete classification of all palindromic factors of a binary automatic word in every integer base, plus all global maximal factors and a sharp all-length palindromic-complexity formula. This connects infinite sparse-marker geometry and classical palindrome complexity, and reveals an exact special base-two parity regime without resort to an arbitrary numerical cutoff.
